name: 北大侠客行
english_description: The well-known Peking University wuxia MUD 北大侠客行 (PKUXKX), a large ES-II-descended tree distinct from this collection's 侠客行一百 snapshots (xkx100/xkx2017/xkx2001). New characters type new, pick an English id, a 1-6 character Chinese name, a complexity-checked password, email, and gender, then land in 未明谷 (Weiming Valley), the PKU-themed newbie area, until they finish the village tutorial. In-game text is Chinese (look/score/quit). Admin is a standard wizlist file. No MySQL required for play.
